mapper.update: UPDATE ai_knowledge_parse_job SET status = 'RUNNING', message = '文档解析中', error_stack = NULL, start_time = #{now}, finish_time = NULL, update_time = #{now} WHERE id = #{jobId} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM ai_knowledge_parse_job WHERE status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY create_time ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
